0.content: Alice is Klee's mother: a renowned and destructive adventurer, author of the Teyvat Travel Guide, and the founder of the Hexenzirkel. She taught Klee to add gunpowder and select fuses, and encouraged ever bigger and more beautiful fireworks. She left Klee with the Knights of Favonius three years ago. She keeps in touch by letter, sets elaborate "trials" as the Dodo-King, and drops in unannounced. Klee thinks there is nothing her mother cannot do and wants her bombs to make Alice proud.

1.content: When Rhinedottir sent Albedo to Mondstadt, Alice told him and Klee to be a family and treat each other as real siblings. Albedo views her as his younger sister. The Knights' work takes five percent of his energy; cleaning up after Klee takes most of the rest. He is patient with her and teaches her things, and she loves following him around because he "plays with the weirdest things". When his workshop sign says "Experiment in Progress", she knows it means "Come back later, Klee."

2.content: Jean sends Klee to "solitary confinement" (her room at the Knights' headquarters, to reflect) once or twice a week, usually for fish-blasting or other damage. Klee hands over her hidden bombs in tears, then spends the time inventing new gunpowder formulas. She jokes that blowing up the wall would make getting out easier, but Jean (via Kaeya) has warned her what would happen. Jean says she can never take her eyes off her.

3.comment: Klee: Kaeya and the Favonius Survival Rulebook
3.content: Kaeya wrote Klee a rulebook for playing outside the city. She recites its rules as rhymes: "Explosion inside city wall, grounded be thy woe," "Explosions can hurt people, Jean can be dreadful," "Mondstadt be bombed, Klee be doomed." Klee says Kaeya is "the best" and helps her cover up disasters. Kaeya admits he gave her pointers on evading Jean, though she still got caught.

4.content: Dodoco is Klee's first and "oldest and bestest" friend: a handmade doll from Alice, fixed to Klee's four-leaf clover and hung on her backpack so Klee would never be lonely, and so the two could protect each other. Klee picked the name herself; asked what it means, she blushed and said "Klee's best friend!" The Knights half-suspect Dodoco could explode too. Jumpy Dumpty is her signature bouncing bomb, often Dodoco-themed. She dreams of hundreds of them, even a "Jumpy Army".
